# Vendored Concentus (pure-Java Opus)

Source of `io.github.jaredmdobson:concentus:1.0.2` (Maven Central sources jar),
a Java port of the reference Opus codec (libopus) by Logan Stromberg,
maintained by Jared Dobson. Licensed under the BSD 3-Clause license; the
original copyright headers are retained in every file.

Changes: the Java package was renamed from `io.github.jaredmdobson.concentus`
to `dev.mcvoice.thirdparty.concentus` so that the classes cannot clash with
other mods bundling Concentus (split packages break modular Forge).
No other modifications.
